create_col_expression: create a deferred column expression with pd.col(col_name) for use in DataFrame.assign or DataFrame.loc
test_expression_filtering: test the Expression class for building boolean filter expressions like pd.col('speed') > 105
build_expression_arithmetic: build an Expression with arithmetic operations like pd.col('a') + pd.col('b') * 2
